title: Night Don Fall
tagline: The last danfo has dropped you. Your house is twenty minutes away, and the boys are somewhere ahead.

bonus.label: Keep your phone and money
bonus.lostMessage: You lost your money or your phone, so the bonus is gone.
bonus.earnedLine: You kept your phone and your money.

cash_low.label: No money left
cash_low.tip: You can't pay your way again.

dropped_name.label: You used a big name
dropped_name.tip: Lie gets easier, until somebody checks.

text.default: 10:40pm. The danfo conductor shouts 'Last stop!' and everybody climbs down. Street lights are off, again. Your house is twenty minutes away on foot, and you and {rival} are both walking home: whoever gets to the gate first tells the story first. A last keke is idling at the junction, and the main road is dark but empty.
text.coop: 10:40pm. The danfo conductor shouts 'Last stop!' and everybody climbs down. Street lights are off, again. Your house is twenty minutes away on foot, and you and {partner} are walking home together. A last keke is idling at the junction, and the main road is dark but empty.
text.solo: 10:40pm. The danfo conductor shouts 'Last stop!' and everybody climbs down. Street lights are off, again. Your house is twenty minutes away on foot. A last keke is idling at the junction, and the main road is dark but empty.

stakes.default: Choose how you walk home. The way you start shapes the whole night.

choices.label: Sweet-talk the last keke rider into one more trip
Walk fast down the main road, head down, no stopping
Start a loud phone call: 'Yes Daddy, I dey close, come out with the boys!'
Take the inner street where people are still outside

recap.default: {winner} sweet-talks the keke man, who sighs and says 'last one o'. {loser} stands there looking sorry.
recap.coop: You sweet-talk the keke man, and he sighs and says 'last one o'.

recap.default: {winner} walks fast down the main road and does not look back. {loser} is jogging behind.
recap.coop: You walk fast down the main road and do not look back.

recap.default: {winner}'s fake call is so loud that two men by the road look up. {loser} follows behind, feeling like a small boy.
recap.coop: Your fake call is so loud that two men by the road look up.

recap.default: {winner} takes the inner street, where a woman is closing her shop. She nods at them. {loser} was looking at the wrong road.
recap.coop: You take the inner street, where a woman is closing her shop. She nods at you.

both_fail.recap: You argue about which way to go, and the keke leaves. The junction gets quieter, and two men start walking towards you from the shadows.

tie.recap: The keke man is too tired to decide, so you both end up walking the inner street.

keke.title: Last Keke
keke.text: The keke rider is half asleep with his head on the steering wheel. 'Last trip,' he says. 'But I no go pass the bridge. After the bridge, area boys dey run things.' The meter is your mouth. He is waiting for you to speak.
keke.stakes: He can carry you to the bridge only, unless you convince him otherwise.

choices.label: Talk Arsenal with him until he warms up and moves further
Pay ₦2,500 to go past the bridge

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Tell him you are a police officer's son and he must take you to the gate
Ask which streets he fears and agree to the bridge only

recap.default: {winner} talks about Arsenal and the keke man drops them right before the rope, where the boys know him. 'Na my passenger.' {loser} climbs down behind them.
recap.coop: You talk about Arsenal and the keke man drops you right before the rope, where the boys know him. 'Na my passenger.'

recap.default: {winner} pays ₦2,500, and the keke goes past the bridge. Ahead, a crowd is running in every direction. {loser} stares at the empty pocket.
recap.coop: You pay ₦2,500, and the keke goes past the bridge. Ahead, a crowd is running in every direction.

recap.default: {winner} says 'police officer's son' and the rider nods slowly. Then a vigilante man steps out with a torch. 'Police, abi? Show me.' {loser} hides behind the headrest.
recap.coop: You say 'police officer's son' and the rider nods slowly. Then a vigilante man steps out with a torch. 'Police, abi? Show me.'

recap.default: {winner} asks which streets he fears and agrees to the bridge. At the bridge, he knows a shortcut through the generator row. {loser} just follows.
recap.coop: You ask which streets he fears and agree to the bridge. At the bridge, he knows a shortcut through the generator row.

both_fail.recap: You argue about price until the rider gives up. He drops you at the bridge, and two men step out.

tie.recap: The rider says nothing and drops you right before the rope.

main_road.title: The Long Road
main_road.text: The main road is long and dark. A few shops are shut. Far ahead, a small fire is burning and you can hear voices. A motorbike passes slowly and the rider looks at you twice. Your legs want to run. Your head says don't.
main_road.stakes: Don't look like prey. Keep your head up and your pace steady.

choices.label: Greet the vigilante men by the road like you know them
Run through the dark stretch before anyone can stop you
Slow down and tell the bike rider you are meeting your 'boys' down the road
Cut into a side street where you can see lights

recap.default: {winner} greets the men by the fire. One of them nods. 'Who be you?' They are curious, not hostile. {loser} stays two steps behind.
recap.coop: You greet the men by the fire. One of them nods. 'Who be you?' They are curious, not hostile.

recap.default: {winner} runs hard until a rope across the road stops everything. {loser} arrives out of breath.
recap.coop: You run hard until a rope across the road stops everything.

recap.default: {winner} tells the bike rider about 'the boys'. He smiles and rides off, then comes back with two friends. {loser} sees them first.
recap.coop: You tell the bike rider about 'the boys'. He smiles and rides off, then comes back with two friends.

recap.default: {winner} cuts into a side street with lights and music. People are still outside selling things. {loser} sticks close.
recap.coop: You cut into a side street with lights and music. People are still outside selling things.

both_fail.recap: You both freeze at the wrong time. The bike comes back, this time with three men.

tie.recap: A fight starts ahead, loud and sudden. You both wait too long to decide.

loud_call.title: Who Is That?
loud_call.text: Your fake call is loud, and it works a little too well. A torch beam finds you. Footsteps come from two directions. 'Who dey talk?' a voice asks from behind a parked trailer. Your phone is still glowing in your hand.
loud_call.stakes: You made noise. Now you have to deal with whoever heard it.

choices.label: Turn around slowly and laugh: 'Oga! I dey rehearse for church drama!'
Keep walking fast and pretend you did not hear
Keep up the act and say your 'boys' dey come
Put the phone in your pocket, stop talking and wait until they show themselves

recap.default: {winner} laughs and explains the 'church drama'. A vigilante steps out, shining the torch at a face. 'Church drama? At this hour?' {loser} says nothing.
recap.coop: You laugh and explain the 'church drama'. A vigilante steps out, shining the torch at your face. 'Church drama? At this hour?'

recap.default: {winner} keeps walking. Behind, voices rise. 'Stop him!' Suddenly the whole street is running in the dark. {loser} is dragged along.
recap.coop: You keep walking. Behind, voices rise. 'Stop him!' Suddenly the whole street is running in the dark.

recap.default: {winner} keeps up the act. 'My boys dey come o!' The men start laughing. One of them says, 'Oya, bring the boys.' You walk straight into the area boys' rope. {loser} stops.
recap.coop: You keep up the act. 'My boys dey come o!' The men start laughing. One of them says, 'Oya, bring the boys.' You walk straight into the area boys' rope.

recap.default: {winner} pockets the phone and stops talking. The men look at each other, then walk away. {winner} takes the next street, through the generator row. {loser} just follows.
recap.coop: You pocket the phone and stop talking. The men look at each other, then walk away. You take the next street, through the generator row.

both_fail.recap: You both panic and shout different things at the same time. Nobody understands anyone.

tie.recap: A vigilante man steps out of the shadow and looks you both up and down.

inner_street.title: Inner Street
inner_street.text: The inner street is narrow and noisy. A woman is frying akara under a gas lantern. A group of boys sits on plastic chairs outside a shut shop, watching. Everybody knows everybody here, and everybody just saw you.
inner_street.stakes: You are a stranger here. Walk like you belong.

choices.label: Buy akara from the woman and greet everybody as you pass
Walk quickly and keep your hands in your pockets
Tell the boys you are Mama Tola's nephew from the next street
Study how the people are sitting, and walk on the side where there are more people

recap.default: {winner} buys akara and the woman smiles. 'Eat first, young man.' The boys nod. {loser} was waiting by the corner.
recap.coop: You buy akara and the woman smiles. 'Eat first, young man.' The boys nod.

recap.default: {winner} walks quickly. Just then, a fight breaks out outside a bar, and the whole street starts moving. {loser} has to run too.
recap.coop: You walk quickly. Just then, a fight breaks out outside a bar, and the whole street starts moving.

recap.default: {winner} says 'Mama Tola's nephew'. One of the boys says, 'Which Mama Tola? I know three.' {loser} laughs a little too loud.
recap.coop: You say 'Mama Tola's nephew'. One of the boys says, 'Which Mama Tola? I know three.'

recap.default: {winner} walks where the crowd is, and the vigilante men sitting by their plastic chairs nod at them. {loser} is two steps behind.
recap.coop: You walk where the crowd is, and the vigilante men sitting by their plastic chairs nod at you.

both_fail.recap: You both hesitate. The boys stand up from their chairs, slowly.

tie.recap: You both pass quietly, and the street lets you go. For now.

stuck_junction.title: Still At The Junction
stuck_junction.text: The keke is gone. The two men are close now, walking slowly like people with all night. One of them is chewing something. 'Oga, wetin you dey find for here this time?'
stuck_junction.stakes: Everything is going wrong. Don't make it worse.

choices.label: Smile and say you are lost and just need directions
Pull out a note and give it first: 'For your trouble, oga'

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Say you are with the vigilante group, and they are coming
Walk backwards slowly towards the lit shop at the corner and keep eye contact

recap.default: {winner} says they are lost, and the men laugh. 'Come, we go show you road.' They walk you right to the rope. {loser} is already behind them.
recap.coop: You say you are lost, and the men laugh. 'Come, we go show you road.' They walk you right to the rope.

recap.default: {winner} gives a note. The man takes it and says, 'Good. Now the phone.' {loser} watches it happen.
recap.coop: You give a note. The man takes it and says, 'Good. Now the phone.'

recap.default: {winner} says 'vigilante group'. A torch lights up from nowhere. 'Who be this one?' says a different voice. {loser} breathes out.
recap.coop: You say 'vigilante group'. A torch lights up from nowhere. 'Who be this one?' says a different voice.

recap.default: {winner} backs away slowly towards the lit shop. The men decide it is not worth it and go. {loser} is shaking, but safe.
recap.coop: You back away slowly towards the lit shop. The men decide it is not worth it and go.

both_fail.recap: Both of you try different things and end up with nothing. The men step closer.

tie.recap: Nobody does anything useful. The men step in.

rope.title: The Rope
rope.text: A rope is stretched across the road, tied to a pole on one side and a boy's wrist on the other. Five boys, one gas lantern. 'Oga, na toll o! Pay and pass!' Behind them, the last street before your house is dark.
rope.stakes: They want something before you pass. Decide what they get.

choices.label: Greet them like you live here and ask for 'Chairman' by name
Pay ₦500 and pass without a word

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Say your 'brother' is the boys' leader, and name a big man
Ask what the toll is for and listen carefully to what they say

recap.default: {winner} greets them by name and one of them says, 'Ah! Na the guy from the other street.' The rope drops. {loser} has to wait for the next boy.
recap.coop: You greet them by name and one of them says, 'Ah! Na the guy from the other street.' The rope drops.

recap.default: {winner} pays ₦500. The boy pockets it, lifts the rope and says 'Next time, bring ₦1,000.' {loser} watches the money go.
recap.coop: You pay ₦500. The boy pockets it, lifts the rope and says 'Next time, bring ₦1,000.'

recap.default: {winner} says the name. One of the boys says 'I know that name' and picks up his phone. The rope drops, but two boys start walking behind you. {loser} follows.
recap.coop: You say the name. One of the boys says 'I know that name' and picks up his phone. The rope drops, but two boys start walking behind you.

recap.default: {winner} asks what the toll is for. The boys, surprised, explain: street light money. 'Small something go do.' The rope drops. {loser} takes the other side.
recap.coop: You ask what the toll is for. The boys, surprised, explain: street light money. 'Small something go do.' The rope drops.

both_fail.recap: The boys do not like how you both answered. The rope drops, but two of them follow behind with their phones out.

tie.recap: Nobody wins. A boy lifts the rope for you after a long stare, mostly because he is bored.

pocket_check.title: Pocket Check
pocket_check.text: Two men have you against a gate. One holds your sleeve. 'Oga, bring the phone. And the pocket money too.' The other looks around. A generator is roaring somewhere close, so nobody will hear you anyway.
pocket_check.stakes: You are in a bad spot. Think hard before your next move.

choices.label: Stay calm and talk like they are neighbours: 'Guys, no problem, what do you need?'
Hand over ₦1,000 from your pocket and keep the phone

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Say your 'security friend' is two minutes away
Say loudly: 'Okay, okay! Take it! But please let me keep my SIM'

recap.default: {winner} talks to them like neighbours. One of them lowers his hand. 'You get sense, o.' They let go of the sleeve. {loser} is shaking.
recap.coop: You talk to them like neighbours. One of them lowers his hand. 'You get sense, o.' They let go of your sleeve.

recap.default: {winner} hands over ₦1,000 and keeps the phone. They take it and disappear. {loser} sees it all.
recap.coop: You hand over ₦1,000 and keep the phone. They take it and disappear.

recap.default: {winner} says a security friend is coming. One of the men laughs and puts his hand in his pocket. {loser} tries to speak but nothing comes out.
recap.coop: You say a security friend is coming. One of the men laughs and puts his hand in his pocket.

recap.default: {winner} shouts 'Okay, okay!' so loud that a door opens nearby and somebody shouts 'Who is there?' The men run. {loser} slides down the gate.
recap.coop: You shout 'Okay, okay!' so loud that a door opens nearby and somebody shouts 'Who is there?' The men run.

both_fail.recap: Both of you try different things and the men take the phone anyway, then run.

tie.recap: A light comes on in a window above. The men run, and so do you.

vigilante.title: The Torch
vigilante.text: A torch beam hits your face. Three vigilante men step out from behind a gate, one with a long stick. 'Who be you? Where you dey go? No be you I see running?' They look tired and suspicious, and they have decided something about you already.
vigilante.stakes: These men can protect you or arrest you. It depends on what you say.

choices.label: Greet the oldest one respectfully and introduce yourself by your house number
Offer them ₦500 for 'drinks' to forget the whole matter

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Say you are a police officer in plain clothes
Tell them your street and compound, and offer to call someone there

lock.reason: Your phone is gone, so you can't do this.

recap.default: {winner} greets the oldest one respectfully and mentions a house number. He says, 'Ah! The Okafor boy?' and the stick comes down. {loser} has been smiling for too long.
recap.coop: You greet the oldest one respectfully and mention a house number. He says, 'Ah! The Okafor boy?' and the stick comes down.

recap.default: {winner} offers ₦500. They take it, but one of them says 'Next time, don't run at night.' {loser} sees the money disappear.
recap.coop: You offer ₦500. They take it, but one of them says 'Next time, don't run at night.'

recap.default: {winner} says 'plain clothes police'. One of the men asks for an ID. {winner} says it is at home. They send someone to walk behind, 'just to be sure'. {loser} is pale.
recap.coop: You say 'plain clothes police'. One of the men asks for an ID. You say it is at home. They send someone to walk behind you, 'just to be sure'.

recap.default: {winner} gives their street and compound and offers to call someone from the compound. The oldest man says, 'No need.' They know the street. {loser} lets out a breath.
recap.coop: You give your street and compound and offer to call someone from the compound. The oldest man says, 'No need.' They know the street.

both_fail.recap: The men do not like either answer. They send one man to 'escort' you the rest of the way, and he does not talk.

tie.recap: Neither of you gives a clear answer. The men confer, then wave you off slowly.

uproar.title: Everybody Run
uproar.text: A fight spills out of a bar. Bottles. Shouting. A man is thrown across the road in front of you and the whole street starts running, some towards you and some away. You hear somebody say 'Police! Police!' and you do not know if it is true.
uproar.stakes: This is chaos. Get out before you get pulled into it.

choices.label: Move with a group of people your size and look like you belong to them
Run through the crowd with your phone held tight
Shout 'Police!' to clear a path through the crowd
Step into a shop doorway and wait for the first wave to pass

recap.default: {winner} moves with a group and nobody looks twice. They end up two streets down, near the gate. {loser} had been standing alone and gets stuck in the crowd.
recap.coop: You move with a group and nobody looks twice. You end up two streets down, near your gate.

recap.default: {winner} runs through the crowd and gets pushed into a wall. The phone survives, but a hand tugs the pocket and ₦1,000 is gone. {loser} is further behind.
recap.coop: You run through the crowd and get pushed into a wall. The phone survives, but a hand tugs your pocket and ₦1,000 is gone.

recap.default: {winner} shouts 'Police!' and the crowd splits. For a moment, it works. Then somebody shouts, 'That one is not police!' and a man starts to follow. {loser} is already running.
recap.coop: You shout 'Police!' and the crowd splits. For a moment, it works. Then somebody shouts, 'That one is not police!' and a man starts to follow.

recap.default: {winner} waits in a doorway. The first wave passes, and the street is almost empty when {winner} steps out. {loser} is still running.
recap.coop: You wait in a doorway. The first wave passes, and the street is almost empty when you step out.

both_fail.recap: You both get pushed in different directions. Someone steps on your foot, someone else takes a phone. You get out eventually, shaken.

tie.recap: The fight moves away from you both by luck. You look at each other and keep walking.

generator_row.title: Thief! Thief!
generator_row.text: The street is loud with generators and lit with phone torches. You walk through, and then somebody shouts, 'Thief! Thief!' Heads turn. Everybody is looking at the only stranger on the street, and that is you.
generator_row.stakes: Don't let anybody decide you are the thief.

choices.label: Stop, raise your hands and laugh: 'Oga, na me? Wetin I carry?'
Walk faster and keep your head down until you are past them
Shout back: 'Thief? Where? Make we find am!'
Slow down, keep your hands visible, and look for the person who shouted

recap.default: {winner} laughs and raises both hands. A woman says, 'No be this one o, na the one wey run!' The crowd looks elsewhere. {loser} was staring at the ground.
recap.coop: You laugh and raise both hands. A woman says, 'No be this one o, na the one wey run!' The crowd looks elsewhere.

recap.default: {winner} walks faster and nobody stops them, but someone grabs a bag strap and a note falls out. ₦1,000 gone. {loser} steps over it.
recap.coop: You walk faster and nobody stops you, but someone grabs your bag strap and a note falls out. ₦1,000 gone.

recap.default: {winner} shouts 'Make we find am!' and joins the search. It works for a minute. Then a man says, 'Wait, you were the first person I saw.' He follows. {loser} stays quiet.
recap.coop: You shout 'Make we find am!' and join the search. It works for a minute. Then a man says, 'Wait, you were the first person I saw.' He follows.

recap.default: {winner} slows down and finds the man who shouted. He is pointing at someone else entirely. The crowd follows him. {loser} slips away.
recap.coop: You slow down and find the man who shouted. He is pointing at someone else entirely. The crowd follows him.

both_fail.recap: The crowd cannot decide who the thief is. Two men follow you both, 'just to be sure'.

tie.recap: The shouting moves down the street. Nobody is sure what happened, and you both walk on.

gate_clean.title: Your Gate: Smooth
gate_clean.text: You turn into your street and your gate is right there, lit by the neighbour's generator. Nobody is behind you. For the first time tonight, your shoulders drop. The last thing is to get inside and tell it your way.

stakes.default: Get inside first and tell the story your way.

choices.label: Call out to the gateman cheerfully so he opens up fast
Jog the last stretch and get to the gate first
Make the story bigger in your head and tell it loudly as you enter
Walk in calm, lock everything, then plan the story

gate_shaken.title: Your Gate: Shaken
gate_shaken.text: You reach your street, breathing hard. Something is missing, or somebody almost took it. The gate is lit but the gateman is asleep. You still need to get inside and make sense of tonight.

stakes.default: Get inside first, and don't let your face show everything.
stakes.coop: Get inside together and calm down.

choices.label: Wake the gateman gently and make a small joke to calm yourself
Bang the gate hard and call his name until he wakes

lock.reason: You don't have money left to pay with.

choices.label: Tell the gateman you 'only just escaped some boys' and watch how it lands
Take a deep breath, check your pockets, and then call the gateman quietly

gate_followed.title: Your Gate: Somebody Is Behind You
gate_followed.text: You see your gate, but you also hear footsteps behind you. Not close. Just steady. You cannot lead them to your house, and you cannot stand in the street either. The gateman is awake, at least.

stakes.default: Get inside first without showing where you live.
stakes.coop: Get inside together without leading them in.

choices.label: Greet the gateman loudly so the person behind you thinks you have people nearby
Pass your gate, turn at the next street and double back
Turn around and shout, 'Oga, you dey follow me for what?'
Stand near the neighbour's lit gate until the person behind you walks past

endings.win: You push your gate open first, with your phone, your money and your mouth all intact. You tell the story your way. {loser} buys suya tomorrow and tells it badly.
endings.loss: When you reach the gate, {winner} is already inside telling the story with big hands. You buy the suya.

success.default: You both get to the gate together, tired but fine. Nobody walks alone again.
success.solo: You get to the gate tired but fine. Next time, you will take a Bolt.

fail.default: You get home late and shaken, with half your things. The group chat will have the story before you sleep.
fail.solo: You get home late and shaken, with half your things. The group chat will have the story before you sleep.

epilogues.text: Since that night, you read every street before you walk it.
The boys now greet you by name whenever you pass. It is respect, or something close.
The boys have your face in their memory now. Avoid that road for a while.
You paid small money to get home. Next time you will carry a ₦200 note separately.
You got home with an empty pocket and a very long story.
Your phone went off in the dark. You charged it fully for three days after.
The big name you used got back to its owner. Enjoy that conversation.
The vigilante men now wave at you from their plastic chairs every evening.
You will be buying a new phone this month.
